entry_signature: _validate_evidence_claim(record: Mapping[str, JSONValue], observed_bindings: Mapping[str, JSONValue], case_policy: Mapping[str, JSONValue]) -> EvidenceCheck

local_types.JSONValue: None | bool | int | str | list[JSONValue] | dict[str, JSONValue]; float not used for digests/PIDs/time samples
local_types.EvidenceIssue: frozen dataclass(code: EvidenceCode, pointer: RFC6901 absolute string)
local_types.EvidenceCheck: frozen dataclass(classification: Literal[SCHEMA_VALID, REJECTED], issue: EvidenceIssue | None, evidence_scope: Literal[SCHEMA_UNIT]); never returns PASS or native verdict

preconditions: All three inputs borrowed read-only, no mutation or normalization
observed_bindings.mode must be SCHEMA_UNIT for this first pure slice; fixture facts are synthetic test doubles
No native collector, PID lookup, filesystem hashing, process launch, file write, network or live aggregation capability in this slice
postconditions: SCHEMA_VALID iff all declared structural/cross-field checks pass against supplied facts; NOT proof those facts physically exist
REJECTED has exactly the first declared EvidenceIssue; stable priority below, no assertion weakening
Inputs remain deeply/canonically equal before and after both success and error
No native/system PASS can be produced by this return type or incorporated as actual evidence

checks: record format/module/case shape; RFC3339 timestamp includes timezone; hash/PID primitive syntax
priority_groups.tie_break: schema property order from existing record-fields.json, then RFC6901 index order

checks: required nonempty valid source inventory hash
required build manifest source reference and manifest SHA
actual artifact SHA equals manifest executable SHA and supplied expected artifact binding
canonical root ownership proof for each root, not caller boolean or path prefix
E0/E1/E2 cannot satisfy native-layer required case
profile and source-preservation requirements from case policy

non_PASS_records: NOT RUN/BLOCKED record may retain truthful read-only artifact identification, but cannot invent PID/start/result/capture. Validate present fields, shape and truthful missing prerequisite representation; do not require an executable or Win11 to validate its schema.
timestamp_rule: RFC3339 timezone Z or explicit offset required; date/time/offset validity checked, no locale parsing. Missing timezone has specific E_TIMESTAMP_OFFSET_REQUIRED.
source_inventory_rule: Missing, null or empty /source/dirty_inventory_sha256 receives E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED before generic digest-shape validation; present wrong-length/case token receives E_DIGEST_FORMAT.
PID_rule: EXECUTED requires type exactly int (bool is not int here), 1 <= pid <= 4294967295; reject0/negative/out-of-range without touching OS.
source_truth_boundary: Supplied bindings do not establish authenticity. A later separately designed/approved native runner must acquire actual observations and own aggregation. No untrusted record can grant itself authority by setting eligibility, root boolean, illustrative flag or PID.
runtime_aggregation: OUT_OF_SCOPE; no native PASS result type/function in H1

applicability.all_records: mode guard, closed shape, required source identity syntax, timestamp and every present field type; output always SCHEMA_UNIT
applicability.non_PASS_records: may remain truthfully BLOCKED without Win11/eligible artifact/owned native fixture; NOT RUN state requires pid/start/selected path null, no operation_result or captures; surplus process fields use E_UNEXECUTED_PROCESS_FIELDS, captures use E_UNEXECUTED_CAPTURE
applicability.executed_failure_records: retain actual provided process identity/evidence when known; require supplied binding consistency without treating it as a PASS; no facts invented for a missing prerequisite

shape_policy.closed_objects: top-level and each named source/artifact/environment/execution/fixture/evidence/result object reject unknown fields; operation_result is explicitly free JSON scalar/object/null, source-hash maps use fixture-relative IDs
shape_policy.required: all original record-fields.json keys are required, except specifically nullable fields still require the key

error_mapping.missing_key: E_FIELD_REQUIRED at exact missing pointer, with source inventory special case E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED

shape_policy.specific_primitive_precedence: format/PID/digest/source inventory/timestamp specialized errors precede generic type check at that same field; missing source inventory always uses E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED
shape_policy.maps_and_refs: original_source_hashes_before_after requires per-fixture {before:64hex,after:64hex}; capture refs are opaque lookup keys resolved only against supplied capture_bindings, never file-opened
shape_policy.array_order: record arrays retained; issues chosen by stable priority, then documented field/index order; no mutation/default-filling

deterministic_order_note: All vector fields not explicitly mutated retain valid base values. N05 execution-state priority precedes NOT RUN extraneous PID checks; N06 missing manifest precedes artifact/binding checks; N08 process identity precedes capture consistency. Return one stable first issue, never mask a higher-priority mismatch.

tests.target_status: PROPOSED TARGET NOT CREATED; command NOT RUN
tests.fixture_materialization: After approval embed these exact synthetic vectors as private fixture dictionaries in the single permitted test file, or request explicit fixture-file scope before adding external test files; never load a mutable real run as the base.
